copy_policy: Unchanged archival copy, including historical wording and spacing.
review_method: Local review of the archived nine-candidate audit, current source-linked derived CSVs, and the specified evidence extracts. No new nine-issuer source collection was undertaken.
screening_basis: Retrospective, exploratory, purposive, disclosure-conditioned screen. Eligibility, named-project resolution and extraction depth are distinct; no outcome-based exclusion is assigned.

Iberdrola: six matched 2019–2024 hybrid snapshots and source-linked group gas/cogeneration/coal history are completed; project money remains undisclosed.
CLP: six-year CAFF bond-cohort and WENT histories, equity capacity series and endpoint coal bridge are now present.
EDF: separate six-year ownership-share capacity table is completed; fixed project cohort and event reconciliation remain incomplete.
instrument_source_verification: Three instrument-commitment rows use document/page verification recorded on 2026-10-10. These are separately marked in the evidence matrix; the source PDFs were not independently re-fetched during this screening review.
paths_policy: All paths are local research provenance, not intended as public document links.
